entries.title: FR-11 Order history view
FR11-TC-26 [negative] cancel must be refused on an order that is already shipping
FR11-TC-27 [negative] the cancel endpoint itself must refuse a shipping order
FR11-TC-28 [negative] a user must not be able to cancel another user's order
FR11-TC-29 [negative] cancelling an already-canceled order is refused
FR11-TC-30 [negative] cancelling a delivered order is refused
FR11-TC-31 [edge] a non-numeric order total must not render as NaN
FR11-TC-32 [edge] an order total of zero renders as a zero amount
FR11-TC-33 [edge] a negative order total must not be displayed as a price
FR11-TC-34 [edge] a missing order total must not be silently displayed as 0 ₫
FR11-TC-35 [negative] checkout must reject a non-numeric order total
FR11-TC-36 [negative] a failed order fetch must be reported as an error, not as an empty history
FR11-TC-37 [edge] an unexpected response shape must not break the page
FR11-TC-38 [positive] a successful cancel confirms the outcome to the user
FR11-TC-39 [positive] the list reflects the new status without a manual reload
FR11-TC-40 [positive] one rendered row matches the API payload across ID, date, total and status
FR11-TC-41 [negative] an expired but correctly signed token is rejected before history loads
FR11-TC-42 [edge] a nested orders value of the wrong type must not crash the profile
FR11-TC-43 [negative] a validly signed token for a deleted or nonexistent user is not a live session
FR11-TC-44 [negative] the cancel endpoint refuses a request with no token and preserves the order
FR11-TC-45 [edge] two simultaneous cancel requests acknowledge the transition only once
